chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī asked him:
About a woman, when she enters ihram, may she wear trousers? He said: “Yes; she only intends by that covering.”

key_terms.أَحْرَمَتْ: entered the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.السَّتْرَ: covering and modest concealment of the body
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.تُرِيدُ: intends or seeks by the action

ai.seo_question: Can a woman in ihram wear trousers for the sake of covering herself?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman in the state of ihram, permitting her to wear trousers. The reason stated is that her purpose in doing so is covering and modesty, which clarifies the permissibility in this context.
